rules.title: Home rule petition authorizing Boston rent stabilization (H.3744)
rules.requirement: Proposed special law that would authorize the City of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The page gives no cap formula or coverage details, and the bill was sent to a study order on 9/9/2024.
rules.citation: Mass. House Bill H.3744 (193rd General Court, 2023-2024)
rules.quoted_span: By Representative Montaño of Boston, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 3744) of Samantha Montaño (with the approval of the mayor and city council) that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.interaction: State enabling legislation (home rule petition) needed for Boston to adopt rent stabilization. It was not enacted and was sent to a study order (H5035) on 9/9/2024.

rules.title: Home rule petition authorizing Boston tenant eviction protections (H.3744)
rules.requirement: Proposed special law that would authorize the City of Boston to implement tenant eviction protections. The page gives no details on causes, notice or relocation, and the bill was sent to a study order on 9/9/2024.
rules.citation: Mass. House Bill H.3744 (193rd General Court, 2023-2024)
rules.quoted_span: By Representative Montaño of Boston, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 3744) of Samantha Montaño (with the approval of the mayor and city council) that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.interaction: State enabling legislation (home rule petition) needed for Boston to adopt eviction protections. It was not enacted and was sent to a study order (H5035) on 9/9/2024.
